duties.duty: ED26-P15-CH-measure-extension-C008 (partial): The construction or argument owed under proved=annex:p15.stieltjes-construction is not written out in full. The endpoint-limit step proves only the lower end, that inf F is the limit at minus infinity. The upper end is dismissed with 'The upper-end proof is the reversed argument' (handbook/annex/p15/measure-extension.tex line 296), which is a 'similarly' in place of written steps. That upper-end fact, F(infinity) = sup F as the limit at plus infinity including the infinite case, is needed later for targets with right endpoint infinity (annex lines 383-385). Second, the stated conclusion 'Its values on bounded intervals are finite' (body handbook/parts/p15/measure-extension.tex lines 211-212) is never proved for bounded intervals other than the finite-endpoint members I(a,b). The monotonicity step from containment in some (-n,n] is not written (annex lines 401-411).
duties.gap: Covered in the new owned files (upper end written at owned annex 14-29 and 46-56; bounded intervals via containment in (-n,n] and monotonicity at 147-178); route pending.

duties.duty: ED26-P15-CH-measure-extension-C012 (partial): The construction or argument owed under proved=annex:p15.cdf-existence depends on an unstated assumption. The theorem concludes that the law of Q_F equals mu_F and that it is the unique Borel probability law with cumulative function F (body lines 297-299). For this the proof (handbook/annex/p15/measure-extension.tex lines 512-516) cites thm:p15-cdf-laws. That theorem's statement covers only two real random variables (handbook/parts/p15/measurable-probability.tex lines 443-444), and the handbook defines a CDF only for a real random variable (lines 417-425). mu_F, and any Borel probability measure with the same ray values, is never shown to be the law of a real random variable, for example the identity map on (R, B(R), mu_F). No direct argument on the ray pi-system or via the Stieltjes uniqueness clause is written either. So the equality-of-laws and uniqueness conclusions lack a written step.
duties.gap: Covered in the new owned files (identity variable, ray pi-system uniqueness, law of Q_F and uniqueness at owned annex 218-311); route pending.
